DESCRIPTION:
Create a new Ivy project

USAGE:
    ivy init [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
    -v, --verbose                  Enable verbose logging                       
    -n, --namespace <NAMESPACE>    The namespace for the new Ivy project        
        --dangerous-clear          Clear the current folder before creating the 
                                   new project                                  
        --dangerous-overwrite      Clear the current folder before creating the 
                                   new project                                  
        --hello                    Include a simple demo app in the new project 
        --cursor                   Install Cursor MCP integration after project 
                                   creation                                     
        --claude                   Install Claude Code MCP integration after    
                                   project creation                             
        --ignore-git               Skip Git checks and commit                   
    -t, --template <TEMPLATE>      Use a specific template for the new project  
        --select-template          Interactively select a template from         
                                   available options                            
        --prerelease               Include prerelease versions when fetching the
                                   latest Ivy version                           
        --yes-to-all               Skip all prompts and use default values      
        --script                   Create a simple Ivy script file instead of a 
                                   full project
